answer: A near-duplicate is rejected at the summit gate and the submitting identity is flagged, so one good text cannot be reused across aliases. Copying an answer thus yields nothing, and producing 166 genuinely distinct answers per epoch is real inference work with real latency; the falcon ledger keeps the similarity graph, and the oasis review can re-run it. Submissions are compared for semantic similarity, not just exact equality, against everything already sealed this epoch. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
